summary: Confirmed on the actual volatile synthetic fixture runtime, controller and renderPublicSite tree: after preparing a share route on Demo Avery, navigating to Demo Jordan leaves share.url as #/public-profile/demo-avery and renders that stale Avery route in Jordan's readonly share-route field once Jordan's provider read resolves. While the read is held the loading renderer omits the profile action panel; the old field reappears after resolution. A fresh public:share dispatch on Jordan updates it to Jordan and ignores forged payload identity fields. Same-profile alias and anonymous supporter controls pass; captured Sarah remains in its separate static read-only renderer with zero provider calls; missing profile is unavailable and shows no share field. Smallest proposed correction, pending root admission: bind prepared share intent to the profile ID at creation and clear it synchronously at navigation to a different profile identity, preserving aliases and captured-reference priority. No source or Git changes were made.
